 Opening Tips 
 No. 10 Illinois (4-1), coming off an historic win at No. 5 Duke, returns home to face Eastern Illinois (1-5) on Friday night at State Farm Center (8 p.m. CT / BTN). 
 The Fighting Illini will host a pregame ring and banner ceremony celebrating the team's 2026 Final Four. Fans are encouraged to be in their seats by 7:30 p.m. for the start of the ceremony.   
 Andrej Stojakovic enters Friday's game at No. 1 in the kenpom Player of the Year standings. The senior scored a career-high 46 points in the Illini's win at No. 5 Duke on Tuesday, breaking a 69-year-old scoring record for an opposing player at Cameron Indoor Stadium (more on the record-setting night on p. 3). 
 The 99-78 victory at #5 Duke marked the Illini's highest-ranked nonconference road win since 1986 (59-57 at #4 Georgia Tech). The win snapped Duke's 35-game home win streak, the longest in the nation entering the contest, and the 21-point margin was the largest by a nonconference opponent at Cameron Indoor Stadium in 68 years. 
 Illinois is currently No. 2 in kenpom, it's highest rating since March 21, 2021.
 Illinois enters the game riding an 11-game home win streak vs. nonconference opponents. The Illini have won four straight games at State Farm Center, overall, and have won back-to-back games since the team's only loss of the season, 84-78, at then-No. 16 Texas Tech on Nov. 10. The Red Raiders are now ranked ninth.
 The Fighting Illini are coming off the program's first Final Four appearance in 21 years, a 28-9 record to mark the fourth-most wins in school history, and a Big Ten runner-up finish (15-5). 
 Expectations for the 2026-27 season are high once again, as head coach Brad Underwood welcomed back five rotation players from the Final Four run in David Mirkovic , Andrej Stojakovic , Tomislav Ivisic , Zvonimir Ivisic , and Jake Davis while adding an impact transfer in Stefan Vaaks from Providence and a top-15 recruiting class consisting of six freshmen highlighted by High School All-American Quentin Coleman . 
 Preseason All-American David Mirkovic and starter Jake Davis remain out due to injury. Mirkovic has not played following foot surgery in August, while Davis is out recovering from shoulder surgery after sustaining the injury just six minutes into the season opener vs. FDU. 
 The Illini have finished 35th or better in kenpom rating in each of the last seven seasons, with a high of No. 4 in 2020-21. Illinois has had three consecutive top-20 final kenpom rankings:  
 No. 10 in 2023-24
 No. 17 in 2024-25
 No. 5 in 2025-26
 Illinois is the winningest team in Big Ten play this decade and is one of four programs nationally with seven straight 20-win regular seasons. Since the start of the 2019-20 season the Illini have posted 96 B1G victories. During that stretch, the Illini also own the most road wins in league play with 42. 
 Illinois-EIU Storylines 
 Despite having campuses located 50 miles apart, Illinois will face Eastern Illinois on Friday night for just the fourth time in the last 24 years, all coming in the last five seasons.
 Friday marks the 10th meeting between the programs. Illinois has won the previous nine games, all in Champaign.
 Prior to the start of his first season at Illinois, head coach Brad Underwood and the Illini also played a hurricane relief game in Charleston on Nov. 3, 2017. The sellout crowd at Lantz Arena saw the Panthers roll in the second half to an 80-67 victory.
 Illinois assistant coach Geoff Alexander worked for EIU head coach Marty Simmons at Evansville for five seasons (2013-17).
 Illinois Deputy Director of Athletics Tom Michael returned to Illinois in May 2026 after a 12-year stint as Director of Athletics at Eastern Illinois. Michael was a four-year letterwinner for the Fighting Illini from 1991-94. One of the best shooters in program history, he still holds Illini records for season (.493) and career (.449) 3-point percentage. Following his playing career, Michael spent 18 years in the U of I's Division of Intercollegiate Athletics, rising to senior associate athletic director, before taking over at EIU in 2014.
 Tom Michael 's son, Nate Michael, is in his third season as an assistant coach at Eastern Illinois. Earlier in his career, Nate spent three seasons on former Illini head coach Bruce Weber 's staff at Kansas State, first serving as a graduate assistant student manager (2019-21) before moving into a video coordinator role in 2021-22. 
 Fighting Illini G Blake Fagbemi and EIU G Jayden Wright were high school teammates at Benet Academy. The duo helped lead the Redwings to the 2025 IHSA 4A State Championship at State Farm Center when Fagbemi was a senior and Wright was as junior. Fagbemi recorded 14 points, four rebounds and six assists in the 55-54 title game win over Warren to go with 15 points and seven rebounds from Wright.
